recipes.title: Thai cashew chicken with rice, light
recipes.summary: Tender chicken, cashew nuts and crisp vegetables in a savoury-sweet Thai sauce, served with a modest portion of rice.

steps.instruction: Prepare the chicken breast, bell pepper, broccoli, onion, spring onions, garlic and ginger in their listed forms.
Stir the soy sauce, fish sauce, rice wine, brown sugar and salt into a sauce.
Coat the chicken breast with one third of the sauce.
Rest the chicken breast so it absorbs the seasoning.
Cook the white rice until tender and fully steamed.
Toast the cashew nuts in a dry frying pan until lightly golden.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wide frying pan.
Brown the chicken breast until nearly cooked through.
Transfer the chicken breast to a clean plate.
Cook the onion and bell pepper until tender and lightly browned.
Cook the broccoli until bright and just tender.
Return the chicken breast to the pan.
Pour the remaining sauce over the chicken and vegetables.
Simmer until the chicken breast is cooked through and the sauce becomes glossy.
Finish the Thai cashew chicken with the spring onions and cashew nuts.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the chicken mixture and rice separately for up to 3 days. Reheat quickly in a hot pan with a splash of water. Freeze the chicken mixture for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Indian beef kofta curry with rice, light
recipes.summary: Tender beef kofta simmered in a tomato, coconut, ginger and cumin curry with spinach, served with a modest portion of rice.

steps.instruction: Prepare the onion, garlic, ginger, spinach and cilantro in their listed forms.
Mix the ground beef, eggs, half the onion, half the garlic, half the ginger, half the cumin, half the paprika and half the salt.
Shape the ground beef mixture into small kofta.
Rest the kofta so they firm slightly.
Cook the white rice until tender and fully steamed.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a wide saucepan.
Brown the kofta on several sides.
Transfer the kofta to a clean plate.
Heat the remaining vegetable oil in the saucepan.
Cook the remaining onion until soft and golden.
Stir the remaining garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika and salt into the onion.
Add the tomatoes, canned, coconut milk and vegetable broth.
Simmer the curry sauce until slightly thickened.
Return the kofta to the curry sauce.
Simmer until the kofta are cooked through.
Fold the spinach into the curry until wilted.
Finish the Indian beef kofta curry with the cilantro.
Serve the beef kofta curry with the white rice.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the kofta curry and rice separately for up to 3 days. Reheat gently until the beef is steaming. Freeze the curry without the rice for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Italian white bean bruschetta, light
recipes.summary: Crisp bread topped with warm white beans, tomato, garlic and basil, finished with a little parmesan. Extra beans and less bread and oil keep it lighter.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Prepare the bread, onion, garlic, basil and parmesan cheese in their listed forms.
Brush the bread with one third of the olive oil.
Toast the bread until crisp and lightly golden.
Heat the remaining olive oil in a frying pan.
Cook the onion until soft and translucent.
Stir the garlic into the onion until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, canned, and salt.
Simmer the tomato mixture until thick and spoonable.
Fold the white beans into the tomato mixture.
Stir the lemon juice and basil through the white beans.
Spoon the white beans over the toasted bread.
Finish the Italian white bean bruschetta with the parmesan cheese.

recipes.storageNotes: Best assembled just before serving. Refrigerate the bean topping for up to 3 days and reheat gently. Store the bread separately and toast it fresh. Do not freeze assembled bruschetta.

recipes.title: Indian egg bhurji with toast, light
recipes.summary: Soft Indian scrambled eggs with tomatoes, spinach, peppers, ginger and cumin, served with a modest amount of crisp toast.

steps.instruction: Prepare the bread, onion, bell pepper, spinach, garlic, ginger and cilantro in their listed forms.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wide frying pan.
Cook the onion until soft and lightly golden.
Cook the bell pepper until tender at the edges.
Stir the garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika and half the salt into the vegetables.
Add the tomatoes, canned, to the pan.
Simmer the tomato mixture until thick and no longer watery.
Fold the spinach into the tomato mixture until wilted.
Beat the eggs with the remaining salt.
Pour the eggs into the pan.
Fold the eggs gently until softly set and still moist.
Toast the bread until crisp and golden.
Finish the Indian egg bhurji with the cilantro.

recipes.storageNotes: Best eaten immediately. Refrigerate the egg bhurji for up to 2 days and reheat gently in a pan. Store and toast the bread separately. Freezing is not recommended.

recipes.title: Italian chicken and white bean soup, light
recipes.summary: A lighter Italian soup with tender chicken, white beans, zucchini, spinach and vegetables in a tomato and basil broth.

steps.instruction: Prepare the chicken thigh, zucchini, spinach, carrot, celery, onion, garlic, basil and parmesan cheese in their listed forms.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan.
Brown the chicken thigh on several sides.
Transfer the chicken thigh to a clean plate.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery until soft and translucent.
Stir the garlic into the vegetables until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, canned, and vegetable broth.
Bring the soup to a gentle simmer.
Add the white beans and zucchini to the soup.
Simmer until the zucchini begins to soften.
Return the chicken thigh to the soup.
Simmer until the chicken thigh is cooked through and tender.
Fold the spinach into the soup until wilted.
Stir the basil and salt into the soup.
Finish the Italian chicken and white bean soup with the parmesan cheese.
Rest the soup so the flavours settle.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 4 days and reheat gently until the chicken is steaming. Freeze the soup without the parmesan cheese for up to 2 months.
